The town's police run no jail (https://www.florenceaz.gov/police/ lists only the station at 425 N Pinal St); arrestees are booked into the Pinal County Sheriff's Adult Detention Center (https://www.pinal.gov/directory.aspx?did=128), coordinates as HIFLD records it. The facility matcher had taken Florence Hospital (reviewed 2026-09-26)

Phoenix PD runs no jail; in 2009-12, the years of its detention agreements, its arrests were booked at the Maricopa County Sheriff's central intake in the 4th Avenue Jail (later the Intake, Transfer and Release center, https://superiorcourt.maricopa.gov/court-locations/intake-transfer-release/), coordinates as HIFLD records it. The facility matcher had taken ICE's Phoenix District Office (reviewed 2026-09-26)

The sheriff of the independent City of Hopewell is a member of the Riverside Regional Jail Authority with the city council (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/authorities/riverside-regional-jail-authority/; https://rrjva.org/wp/contact-us/), and the city's jail is Riverside Regional Jail; coordinates as HIFLD records it (reviewed 2026-09-26)

Mesa PD's 24/7 holding facility in the basement of its headquarters at Robson and 1st (https://www.mesaaz.gov/Public-Safety/Mesa-Police/About-Mesa-Police/Holding-Facility-Jail; https://www.themesatribune.com/news/mesa-adding-10m-in-public-safety-facility-upgrades/article_d2d8138a-f09d-11ef-9a1f-c74fbcd6eeb1.html), where its 287(g) jail model runs (http://mesapd.blogspot.com/2022/09/what-is-mesa-police-departments.html); every MOA's detention contact is at 130 N Robson; census geocoder coordinates. Processing moved to 1333 N Power Rd during the 2025 headquarters renovation, a temporary site (https://ktar.com/arizona-news/mesa-breaks-ground-on-northeast-public-safety-facility-for-police-fire/5377674/) (reviewed 2026-09-26)

the county's jail at 17 Veterans Square, rebuilt as the Van Buren County Administration Facility & Jail (83 beds) after a fire; HIFLD marks the record Closed as of 2024-01-11, jail listings in 2026 show it operating (jailexchange.com, tennesseeinmates.org); placed on HIFLD's point (review 2026-09-27)

Keller PD's jail, a holding facility under its police department that also holds prisoners for Colleyville, Roanoke, Southlake and Westlake (https://www.cityofkeller.com/services/regional-detention-center); in no facility source; census geocoder coordinates. The facility matcher had taken Euless City Jail (reviewed 2026-09-27)
